caps: HIT/SHIT 17% vs level-63 raid bosses, about 4% vs level-equal mobs (Method hit article; Icy Veins also says 17%). The Forever Nature's Reach talent supplies part of it. Past the cap HIT is worth about 0, so CRIT becomes the top secondary stat.
HASTE has no known cap. It shortens casts and the GCD but does not speed up DoT ticks in Forever, so it loses value near the 1s GCD floor.
BALANCE.notes: Icy Veins ranks Hit (to 17%) > Crit > Spell Power > Int and calls it provisional until level 60 data exists. wow.gg (beta) has SP > Int > Crit > Haste > Spirit. Warcraft Tavern calls SP the most important stat, followed by Hit, Crit, Haste, Int, Spirit. The priority list follows the hit-capped view, which matches the other casters. The weights are per point and per 1%, with SP = 1.0. Forever changes: hit and crit are unified (HIT=SHIT, CRIT=SCRIT). Vengeance makes crits deal +100%, and crits also proc Nature's Grace, so crit is worth more than for most casters. Moonkin aura now gives both spell and physical crit. Eclipse makes you alternate Wrath and Starfire. Hurricane has no cooldown. DoTs update dynamically. Mana is tight (Moonglow and Improved Wrath are key), which justifies a modest MP5/INT weight. Spirit only matters with the deep-Resto Reflection talent. INT to crit uses the classic-era figure of ~60 INT per 1% (gap fill).

caps: HIT/SHIT 8% vs raid bosses, 5% vs level-equal mobs (Icy Veins and Method say 8%; Warcraft Tavern says 9%). Part of it may come from talents. Past the cap HIT is worth about 0.

EXPERTISE 6.5% removes boss dodge when attacking from behind (normal cat position), so weight it about 12 per 1% up to 6.5% and about 0 above that. 14% is needed only if attacking from the front (dodge plus parry). Icy Veins figures. Guides rank it #2 after weapon DPS.
FERAL_CAT.notes: WEAPON DPS MATTERS IN FOREVER. Unlike vanilla, Blizzard made form attacks scale with the weapon: its DPS is added to the form's base damage, and enchants, stones/oils and chance-on-hit procs work while shapeshifted (wow.gg, Warcraft Tavern, Icy Veins, kami-labs). Form swing speed is fixed (1.0s cat, 2.5s bear), so only the DPS number matters, not speed or weapon type. Polearms are now usable. The wowsims Forever sim values 1 weapon DPS = 14 AP, which gives DPS = 14 x AP weight. Icy Veins and wow.gg rank Weapon DPS > Expertise > Hit > Agi > Str, with Crit and AP close to Agi/Str. They put DPS first because a weapon upgrade is a large chunk of it, not because it is worth more per point than 1% hit or crit. Warcraft Tavern ranks Hit > Exp > Crit > Haste > Agi > Str > AP. Conversions: Druids get 2 AP per STR and, in cat form, 1 AP per AGI. 20 AGI = 1% crit. A cat crit is valued at about 28 AP (Primal Fury/LotP, classic-era estimate), so AGI is about 2.4 AP > STR at 2 AP. HIT=SHIT and CRIT=SCRIT because they are unified in Forever. Haste is a gear stat now. It speeds autoattacks, but cat is energy-bound, so it is valued well below crit. Powershifting is not viable. The Shifting Power talent converts mana to energy, so INT gets a token weight.

caps: DEF 440 (+140 over base 300) makes you uncrittable by raid bosses. Bears cannot parry or block, so all of it must come from Defense. Above 440, DEF drops to about 0.9 (avoidance only).

HIT 8% vs raid bosses (threat). EXPERTISE: up to 14% from the front (dodge 6.5% plus parry), per Icy Veins. Estimated at about 4 per 1% (same as HIT) for threat and to cut boss parries, which in vanilla rules also haste the boss's swings. Low-confidence estimate. Above 14% it is about 0.
Armor damage reduction caps at 75% (~17,265 armor vs raid bosses). Unreachable in practice, so ARMOR has no effective cap.
FERAL_BEAR.notes: Icy Veins and wow.gg agree: Armor > Defense > Stamina > Agility > Dodge for survival. Threat stats follow the cat list, and Icy Veins calls weapon DPS the single most valuable stat for bear threat. Warcraft Tavern says Defense > Dodge > Armor > Stamina and adds that Stamina matters because bears have less mitigation than other tanks. The priority list is the guide order. The weights are per point/per 1% (anchor AGI = 1.0), so per-point values differ from the order: 1% dodge is worth more than one point of armor. Bear form multiplies item armor, so ARMOR is weighted from EHP. At ~15k armor, 1 STA is roughly 9 item armor. The Forever bear armor multiplier was not found; I assumed the classic Dire Bear/Thick Hide size (gap fill). Forever: weapon DPS adds to bear base damage (fixed 2.5s swing), so DPS = 14 AP for threat. Lacerate stacks to 5. Furor gives 10 rage on shift. Rage potions now usable in form. Natural Reaction makes dodges give rage, which slightly raises DODGE. HIT=SHIT and CRIT=SCRIT are unified. Haste is low value (white swings only).

RESTORATION.notes: Icy Veins and wow.gg (2026-11-04) agree: Healing Power > Int > Spirit > MP5 (> Crit on wow.gg). Warcraft Tavern says the final order awaits level 60 and lists Healing Power, Spirit, Haste, Crit, Int. The priority list is the guide order. The weights are per point/per 1% (anchor HEAL = 1.0), so MP5 and per-1% CRIT/HASTE are larger per point than INT. SP = HEAL = 1.0: in Forever, healing gear also carries spell power. Forever changes: HoTs can crit, so crit is worth more than in vanilla, though the guides still rank it low. Reflection is raised to 50% and Living Spirit buffs Spirit, so SPI is close to INT. Wild Growth has a 3s cast. Hit and crit are unified (CRIT=SCRIT). Haste is a gear stat but only Warcraft Tavern ranks it.
